The queue depth fell by 90% after the fix. The consumer now drains a burst of 10,000 messages in under one minute. This speedup occurred because the batch size rose from 10 to 500. In addition, the workers no longer share one connection.

The long sentence was split into three shorter sentences.
The original meaning was preserved.
